Played live 'Cell 4 · CC 60' → LVCO ← ADDR-SEQ 'Mod 3 → Frequency +40%, Pre-Filter Gain +7%' (Cv) hand control of frequency & pre-filter gain

Played live 'Gate 13 · A2, Gate 7 · G#2' → Sequencing 'Clkd 'Run', Clkd 'Reset', ADDR-SEQ 'Reset'' (Gate) 3 × gate / trig / clock
Played live '1V/octave pitch' → PULSE ← Host MIDI 'PULSE 'Pitch (1V/octave)', ADSR #2 'Attack', ADSR #2 'Sustain'' (Pitch) 3 × pitch
